title: SemanticMergeOutput
description: Records of `atomwrite semantic-merge`: the `plan` record in `--dry-run`, then the terminal result.

anyOf.title: DryRunPlan
anyOf.description: NDJSON output for dry-run and diff preview operations.

would_modify.description: Whether the operation would modify the file.

details.description: Additional details about the planned change.

risk_assessment.description:
Risk diagnostics of the payload the plan would write. Omitted when
nothing matched the configured patterns, so the field never appears
as an empty object.

write_strategy.description: Write strategy the atomic engine used for the output file.

backup_skipped.description: Why a requested backup was skipped, when the directory refused it.

ok.description: Outcome of the run, stamped by the writer

code.description: Machine error code, present when ok is false

exit.description: Process exit status, present when ok is false

target_resolved.description: Absolute targets the run resolved, in invocation order, and never a joined string, so a path holding `,` stays readable; a run with one target publishes a one-item array, so the shape never depends on the count

target_source.description: Where the target came from: named in the invocation line, inherited from the workspace slot, or the standard-input stream

workspace_source.description: Where the workspace root came from: the `--workspace` flag or the process working directory

records_suppressed.description: Records the writer dropped before the terminal event: `--filter` rejections, `--select` projections that emptied the record, dedupe duplicates and `--limit` cuts. It counts records, never files, so it does not compare with `files_matched`: one file can contribute several records

files_budget_dropped.description: Entries the `--limit` budget dropped, in the unit the verb produces: files for walking verbs, records for streaming ones; a floor, because workers may stop before producing the rest

files_planned.description: Files the run would have modified in `--dry-run` or `--preview`; absent from a run that really wrote

truncated.description: The record itself was cut by `--truncate-content` or `--max-output-bytes`, so the fields are shorter than the source

truncated_records.description: Records the writer cut this run, counted once per record

line_end.description: 1-based last line of that block, when the block spans more than a line.

line.description:
1-based line of the block that holds the syntax error (v0.1.38).

Present only for [`AtomwriteError::SyntaxError`]. Without it the caller
had to re-read the file to learn where the refusal points.

pairs_applied.description:
Pairs that were written to the target before the error (v0.1.37).

Always `0` for the all-or-nothing `EditPairFailed` abort (nothing is
written) and `total - unmatched` for `edit-loop --partial`.

path.description: Filesystem path related to the error, if applicable.

error_class.description: Error class: transient, conflict, `precondition_failed`, or permanent.

retryable.description: Whether a retry may resolve this error.

suggestion.description: Optional actionable suggestion for the caller.

suggestion_lang.description:
Language of `suggestion` when it is not English, so a consumer knows
what it is reading.

workspace.description: Workspace root used for jail validation, if applicable.

failed_pair_index.description: 1-based index of the failed `--old`/`--new` pair (multi-pair edit, G117).

pairs_total.description:
Total number of `--old`/`--new` pairs in the invocation.

Emitted by multi-pair edit (G117) and by a partial `edit-loop` run
(v0.1.36) — one key, two producers.

pair_results.description:
Per-pair diagnostics up to and including the failed pair (multi-pair edit, G117).
Pairs after the failure were never attempted and are absent.

best_candidate.description: Closest near-miss when a match cascade fails (v0.1.29 P0-2).

match_count.description: Match count when ambiguity is reported (v0.1.30).

similar_paths.description: Similar basenames when path is missing (v0.1.30).

conflict_count.description: Number of conflicting regions a three-way merge could not align (v0.1.36).

missing_flag.description:
Flag literal the operation required but did not receive (v0.1.36).

Present only for [`AtomwriteError::MissingFlag`]; the duplicate `code`
on that variant is deliberate — callers branch on `missing_flag` and
still see the `INVALID_INPUT` family in `code`.

pairs_unmatched.description:
Pairs that did not match in a partial `edit-loop` run (v0.1.36).

`pairs_total` already exists above for the multi-pair edit family and
is reused by this variant instead of being duplicated.

anyOf.title: ErrorJson
anyOf.description: Serializable error envelope emitted as a single NDJSON line.

ok.description:
Always false on error envelopes (GAP-2026-020 agent sentinel).

`ok: false` together with `code` is the whole verdict: the redundant
`error: true` duplicate left the envelope because every failure paid
for it and no caller branched on it alone.

path.description: Filesystem path related to the error, if applicable.

WriteRiskAssessment.description:
GAP-2026-011 L1/L6: Local diagnostics describing why a write was classified
as risky (G-031: not product telemetry). Emitted in `WriteOutput.risk_assessment`
when the size delta exceeds the user-configured `--risk-threshold`.

new_bytes.description: New file size after the write.

guard_triggered.description: Which guard triggered the assessment (always "size" for L1).

PairResult.description:
Outcome of matching a single `--old`/`--new` pair in multi-pair edit mode.

Emitted in `pair_results` on both success and error envelopes so agents
can verify each pair objectively without re-running the edit (G117).
In the default all-or-nothing mode, pairs after the first failure are
never attempted and are absent from the array.

index.description: 1-based position of the pair in the `--old`/`--new` invocation order.

matched.description: Whether the pair matched and was applied to the content.

similarity.description: Similarity score of the fuzzy match, 0.0-1.0 (block-anchor and context-aware only).

source.description: Source of the match/replacement content: `"arg"` or `"file"`.

BestCandidate.description:
Closest near-miss when a fuzzy/exact match fails (v0.1.29 P0-2).

Agents use this to correct `old` without re-reading the full file.

text.description: Snippet of the best matching region (truncated to 500 chars).

line.description: 1-based line of the candidate start in the file.

similarity.description: Similarity score 0.0–1.0 of the best attempt.

strategy.description: Strategy that produced this candidate score.
